pr.title: fix(worktree): smarter cleanup behavior for worktrees
pr.body:
<!-- git-stk:description -->
improvements to cleanup w.r.t. worktrees
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

expected.description: Cleanup removes an owned worktree only while it still holds the branch, so a worktree the user detached is left behind and its ownership marker is dropped with the branch, stranding it.
